title: Goodbyes between Hinton and Jones
summary: Hinton says he will miss him and Jones jokes about getting him fired and sending for him in Europe.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Here we are in 1973 and we're all very happy to redo some of these things and put them down as a matter of record. So now I just want to wish you the greatest. I'm going to miss you, old buddy, because when I don't check in with you once or twice 4 week -

You're not going to miss me because I'm going to get you fired like I always do and you probably will have to come over to join Milt Buckner and myself, because we did that with Slam Stewart and I'm pretty sure that with the friends that we know out here, we can get you fired and have you to come over to join us. (laughs)
I'll send for Slam any day, any week.
